reference.title: Experimental study on the dynamic response of voltage and temperature of an open-cathode air-cooled proton exchange membrane fuel cell

predecessor.retained: six steady spatial/airflow parameters and the mesh-consistent finite-volume structure
predecessor.discarded: V12 dynamic fan-release inference and its three dynamic thermal parameters

known_input.ramp_2A: 2 A increments every 50 s, 2 to 40 A loading then unloading
known_input.ramp_4A: 4 A increments every 100 s, 4 to 40 A loading then unloading

data_partition.calibration: Fig.5(e), 2 A ramp, cathode inlet/intermediate/outlet temperature
data_partition.final_confirmation: Fig.5(f), 4 A ramp, cathode inlet/intermediate/outlet temperature
data_partition.independent_spatial_confirmation: V12 held-out Fig.8 group 3 result, parameters not retuned

validated_scope_if_passed: 40-cell thermal plant, 23 C ambient, 2-40 A, fixed 60 percent PWM; variable-PWM control claims remain outside scope
control_use_rule: May be used as a high-fidelity fixed-PWM thermal reference. Variable-duty MPC requires a later multi-PWM confirmation.
